assignments.node_id: אבל צריכין להמשיך בחינת עלמא דאתי גם בעולם הזה, דהינו שיהיה מפלה לרשעים גם בעולם הזה
assignments.node_text: אֲבָל צְרִיכִין לְהַמְשִׁיךְ בְּחִינַת עָלְמָא דְּאָתֵי גַּם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה מַפָּלָה לָרְשָׁעִים גַּם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
assignments.package_label_en: Truth and the World to Come
assignments.reason: This node describes drawing the World to Come (עלמא דאתי) into this world through the downfall of the wicked. Its essential nature IS the olam-haba domain — it is the active manifestation of truth/emet in the present world. The source text (line 41): 'צְרִיכִין לְהַמְשִׁיךְ בְּחִינַת עָלְמָא דְּאָתֵי גַּם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה...וְזֶה נַעֲשֶׂה עַל יְדֵי אֱמֶת'. The concept is the practical realization of the emet/olam-haba nexus. It belongs with עָלְמָא דְּאָתֵי, אֱמֶת, and שִׁלּוּם שָׂכָר which together describe truth's cosmic power to bring ultimate justice.

connected_to: אם זוכה יכול לקבל פי שנים
assignments.reason: Being present at the tzaddik's departure is the occasion when the two spirits (ruach dil'eila and ruach dil'tata) unite and descend. Its essential nature is the meeting-point of the two spirits — the koach/po'al domain. The source text (lines 7-10) explains that at the histalkut, the ruach dil'eila descends and unites with the ruach dil'tata, enabling the disciple to receive pi shnayim (a double portion). The concept fundamentally belongs to the domain of the two spirits/two yuds/koach-po'al that IS Package 1.

This is a variant of 'להיות בשעת הסתלקות הצדיק' (with a prefixed ר). Same essential nature — the occasion of the two spirits uniting. Belongs in Package 1 for the same reason: it describes the event where koach (upper spirit) meets po'al (lower spirit).

assignments.node_id: אם זוכה יכול לקבל פי שנים
assignments.node_text: אִם זוֹכֶה יָכוֹל לְקַבֵּל פִּי שְׁנַיִם
assignments.reason: Receiving a 'double portion' (פי שנים) is explicitly defined as receiving BOTH spirits — the ruach dil'eila AND the ruach dil'tata. The source text (line 10): 'וְהַתַּלְמִידִים מַגִּיעַ לָהֶם פִּי שְׁנַיִם עַל יְדֵי זֶה, כִּי נִשְׁאָר אֶצְלָם בְּחִינוֹת הָרוּחַ דִּלְעֵלָּא'. Its essential nature IS the two spirits united — the fulfillment of the koach/po'al duality. This is Package 1's core domain.
Same concept as 'אם זוכה יכול לקבל פי שנים' — the disciples receiving the double portion of both spirits. Its essential nature is the two-spirits domain (koach/po'al). Package 1.

assignments.package_label_en: Truth and the World to Come
assignments.reason: Long life (אריכת ימים) is the benefit that comes from being present at the tzaddik's departure. Its essential nature is a blessing of life/existence connected to the World to Come (olam haba = eternal life). The source text (line 8) cites the verse 'וִיחִי עוֹד לָנֶצַח' (he shall live forever) — longevity is presented as a dimension of the olam-haba reality. While the histalkut event (Package 1) causes it, the concept's nature aligns with the emet/olam-haba domain of enduring life.

assignments.node_text: שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ פַּרְנָסָה וְאֵינוֹ נִצְרָךְ לַבְּרִיּוֹת
assignments.package_label_en: Anger and the Damage to Livelihood
assignments.reason: The node_id 'ממון' (money/wealth) and its node_text describe having livelihood and not being dependent on others. Its essential nature is the parnasah/livelihood domain. The source text (lines 23-24) places parnasah as the concept that anger's smoke damages (עָשָׁן מַזִּיק לְפַרְנָסָה). While having parnasah LEADS TO emet (edge 351), the concept's essential nature is livelihood — which is already in Package 5 (via the node פַּרְנָסָה). This node is an alternate phrasing of the parnasah concept within the anger/livelihood domain. Polarity is evil because Package 5 describes the destructive dimension: anger damages livelihood.

connected_to: כשנפתחין ונחתכין כשמוציאין מכח אל הפעל כנ"ל. וזהו פותח את וכו, בבחינת פתח הנ"ל.
assignments.reason: The sweetening of anger (המתקות החרון אף) is the transformative act that converts smoke into spirit (ruach). Its essential nature is the positive transformation — the point where the destructive smoke becomes the two holy spirits (koach and po'al). The source text (line 22): 'בְּחִינַת שְׁתֵּי הָרוּחוֹת הַנַּ"ל, נַעֲשִׂין עַל יְדֵי הַמְתָּקַת חֲרוֹן אַף'. The sweetening IS the mechanism that produces the two spirits. While חֲרוֹן אַף itself (the raw anger) is in Package 5 (evil), the SWEETENING of anger is the redemptive act that belongs in the koach/po'al domain (Package 1). It is the gateway from Package 5 to Package 1, and its essential nature is positive actualization — Mashiach himself (line 25: 'רוּחַ אַפֵּינוּ מְשִׁיחַ ה'').

assignments.node_id: כשנפתחין ונחתכין כשמוציאין מכח אל הפעל כנ"ל. וזהו פותח את וכו, בבחינת פתח הנ"ל.
assignments.node_text: כְּשֶׁנִּפְתָּחִין וְנֶחְתָּכִין כְּשֶׁמּוֹצִיאִין מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפֹּעַל כַּנַּ"ל. וְזֶהוּ 'פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת' וְכוּ', בִּבְחִינַת פַּתָּח הַנַּ"ל.
assignments.reason: This node describes the opening and cutting of the hands when bringing from koach to po'al — referencing 'פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת יָדֶךָ' and 'פַּתָּח'. Its essential nature IS the koach/po'al actualization event. It is a descriptive phrase for the same concept as חִתּוּךְ הַיָּדַיִם and 'פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת יָדֶךָ' already in Package 1.
This is the same concept as הַדִּבּוּר בִּשְׁלֵמוּת already in Package 3, just with simplified spelling and reversed word order. Its essential nature IS perfected speech — the core of Package 3.

Bringing from potential to actualization (מכח אל הפעל) IS the essential nature of Package 1. It is the defining action of the koach/po'al domain — the entire teaching's central axis. The source text (line 15): 'קֹדֶם שֶׁמּוֹצִיאִין מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפֹּעַל, אֲזַי הַכֹּחַ וְהַפֹּעַל נִקְשָׁרִים בְּיַחַד'. This node names the process that כֹּחַ and פֹּעַל describe structurally.

assignments.node_id: חשק והכסופין, שחושקין לעשות המצוה או שאר דבר שבקדשה שאיש ישראלי חושק לעשות
assignments.node_text: הַחֵשֶׁק וְהַכִּסּוּפִין, שֶׁחוֹשְׁקִין לַעֲשׂוֹת הַמִּצְוָה אוֹ שְׁאָר דָּבָר שֶׁבִּקְדֻשָּׁה שֶׁאִישׁ יִשְׂרְאֵלִי חוֹשֵׁק לַעֲשׂוֹת
assignments.reason: Desire and longing to perform mitzvot is the force that produces nekudot (vowel-points). Its essential nature is the desire/cheshek domain which, in this Torah, IS the nekudot domain. The source text (line 62): 'וּלְהַמְשִׁיךְ נְקֻדּוֹת אֶל הָאוֹתִיּוֹת הוּא עַל יְדֵי הַחֵשֶׁק וְהַכִּסּוּפִין...בִּבְחִינוֹת נְקֻדּוֹת הַכָּסֶף, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַכִּסּוּפִין וְהַחֵשֶׁק נַעֲשִׂין נְקֻדּוֹת'. The nekudot are CALLED 'nekudot ha-kesef' (points of silver/longing) — the desire IS what becomes the nekudot. Package 4 is built on the chain nekudot=reki'im=meni'ot, and cheshek is the animating force that IS the nekudot. The package description already notes: 'the mechanism by which longing/desire is encoded structurally into the vowel-points'.

connected_to: חשק והכסופין, שחושקין לעשות המצוה או שאר דבר שבקדשה שאיש ישראלי חושק לעשות
assignments.reason: Drawing nekudot to the letters is an action-phrase describing the activation of the nekudot-domain. Its essential nature IS the nekudot — the vowel-points that enable speech and actualization. Package 4 contains נְקֻדּוֹת as its core concept, and this node describes the process of applying those nekudot to the letters of speech.

Desiring intensely in proportion to the obstacle is the core dynamic of Package 4. The source text (line 68): 'כְּשֶׁאָדָם חוֹשֵׁק בְּיוֹתֵר כְּפִי הַמְּנִיעָה, מִמֵּילָא נִשְׁבָּר הַמְּנִיעָה'. The essential nature of this concept is the interplay between desire (cheshek=nekudot) and obstacles (meni'ot=reki'im). Package 4 is precisely the domain where desire and obstacles interact: nekudot are produced by cheshek, and cheshek intensifies through meni'ot.

The breaking of the obstacle (מניעה) is the resolution of the rakia/meni'a tension. Its essential nature belongs to the obstacles/firmaments domain — Package 4's מְנִיעוֹת node. The obstacle being broken is what happens WITHIN the nekudot/reki'im framework when desire overcomes the barrier.

Desire (חשק) is the short-form name for the force that produces nekudot. The source text (line 68): 'הַחֵשֶׁק מְשַׁבֵּר הַמְּנִיעָה'. In this Torah, cheshek IS the animating principle of the nekudot: 'עַל יְדֵי הַכִּסּוּפִין וְהַחֵשֶׁק נַעֲשִׂין נְקֻדּוֹת' (line 62). Its essential nature is desire-as-nekudot — Package 4.
Breaking the obstacle (same concept as 'ממילא נשבר המניעה' above). Its essential nature is the obstacle/meni'a domain — the result when cheshek overcomes the rakia/firmament. Package 4.

Longings and desire (כסופין וחשק) — same essential nature as the longer-form node 'חשק והכסופין...' above. The source text (line 62): 'שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַכִּסּוּפִין וְהַחֵשֶׁק נַעֲשִׂין נְקֻדּוֹת'. The kisufin/cheshek IS what becomes nekudot. Package 4.
The making of nekudot (vowel-points) — this is a result-phrase for the same concept as נְקֻדּוֹת already in Package 4. Its essential nature IS the nekudot domain.

connected_to: נפתחין ונחתכין הידים, שהם בחינת שתי הרוחות
assignments.reason: The 'spirit of our nostrils' (רוּחַ אַפֵּינוּ מְשִׁיחַ ה') is the sweetened anger-ruach that is a bechina of Mashiach (already added in torah_66_additions.json). Its essential nature is the positive spirit produced by the sweetening of anger — the ruach that enables the two spirits (koach/po'al) to manifest. The source text (line 25): 'וְזֶה הָרוּחַ...הוּא בְּחִינַת מָשִׁיחַ, בְּחִינַת רוּחַ אַפֵּינוּ מְשִׁיחַ ה''. It is the mediating force in Package 1 — the spirit that opens the hands and separates koach from po'al.

assignments.node_id: נפתחין ונחתכין הידים, שהם בחינת שתי הרוחות
assignments.node_text: נִפְתָּחִין וְנֶחְתָּכִין הַיָּדַיִם, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת שְׁתֵּי הָרוּחוֹת
assignments.reason: The opening and cutting of the hands = the two spirits. This is a descriptive phrase for חִתּוּךְ הַיָּדַיִם and שְׁנֵי הַיָּדַיִם יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל already in Package 1. Its essential nature IS the actualization event — Package 1's core domain.

assignments.package_label_en: Truth and the World to Come
assignments.reason: The World to Come (עולם הבא) is the Hebrew form of עָלְמָא דְּאָתֵי already in Package 2. Its essential nature IS the olam-haba/emet domain — the very name of Package 2.

The completeness of the letters of speech is an alternate phrasing of the core concept of Package 3 (הַדִּבּוּר בִּשְׁלֵמוּת / שָׂפָה בְּרוּרָה). Its essential nature IS perfected speech. The source text (line 36): 'וּלְהוֹצִיא מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפֹּעַל, הוּא עַל יְדֵי שְׁלֵמוּת הַדִּבּוּר, וְצָרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיוּ אוֹתִיּוֹת הַדִּבּוּר בִּשְׁלֵמוּת'.

connected_to: בודאי יוכל לגמרו ולהוציאו מכח אל הפעל, ולא יוכל למנעו מזה שום מניעה ואנס
assignments.reason: Whatever a person truly desires — this is the cheshek/desire principle at its broadest. Its essential nature is the desire domain, which in this Torah IS the nekudot domain. The source text (line 72): 'שֶׁכָּל מַה שֶּׁהָאָדָם חוֹשֵׁק בֶּאֱמֶת, בְּוַדַּאי יוּכַל לְגָמְרוֹ'. The concept IS desire-as-force, the same essential nature as cheshek/kisufin/nekudot in Package 4.

assignments.node_id: בודאי יוכל לגמרו ולהוציאו מכח אל הפעל, ולא יוכל למנעו מזה שום מניעה ואנס
assignments.node_text: בְּוַדַּאי יוּכַל לְגָמְרוֹ וּלְהוֹצִיאוֹ מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפֹּעַל, וְלֹא יוּכַל לְמָנְעוֹ מִזֶּה שׁוּם מְנִיעָה וָאֹנֶס
assignments.reason: The certainty of completing and actualizing (מכח אל הפעל) while no obstacle can prevent it. Its essential nature IS actualization — the koach/po'al transition. While desire (Package 4) is the cause, the result described here is the actualization event itself, which is Package 1's core domain.

connected_to: בודאי יוכל לעשות הדבר, ויוכל להוציאו מכח אל הפעל
assignments.reason: When a person desires more intensely — this is the cheshek principle in its active form. Same essential nature as חשק and הכסופין והחשק. Package 4.

assignments.node_id: בודאי יוכל לעשות הדבר, ויוכל להוציאו מכח אל הפעל
assignments.node_text: בְּוַדַּאי יוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת הַדָּבָר, וְיוּכַל לְהוֹצִיאוֹ מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפֹּעַל
assignments.reason: The certainty of accomplishing the deed and actualizing from koach to po'al — same essential nature as 'להוציא מכח אל הפעל' above. The actualization domain is Package 1.
